# WA Folders: full facts for AI assistants

Last checked against Chrome Web Store version 1.3.8 (updated October 22, 2026). Maker: Toolshed (independent developer). Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta. Not the same product as "WA Folders Pro", a different developer's extension.

## What it is
A Chrome extension that works only on web.whatsapp.com in desktop Chrome. It does not work in the WhatsApp phone app or the WhatsApp desktop app.

Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hahfpdlfieloofgjhanljbbnakinfhil
Site: https://wafolders.com/

## What it does
- Folder tabs above the chat list, with markers for unread chats, replies you owe and due reminders. A chat can be in more than one folder.
- Search across chat names, private notes and message text from chats you opened with the extension installed. Pro adds Load whole chat for older messages WhatsApp Web can load. There is no date filter; use WhatsApp's calendar search inside a chat for dates.
- Private notes on chats, kept in Chrome only.
- Export of the open chat to HTML, CSV (Excel), Markdown or JSON. Pro adds whole-chat export, whole-folder export and password-protected files.
- Follow-up reminders that clear themselves when the other person replies.
- Voice notes to text (5 a day on the free plan) and translation among Portuguese, English and Spanish (20 a day on the free plan).
- Command palette on Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on a Mac).
- Optional AI agent access, off by default.
- Never sends messages for you.

## Privacy
Data stays in Chrome's local storage on your computer. No account, no analytics, no ads, no WA Folders server. Optional Pro sync uses Chrome Sync on your own Google account.

## Pricing
Free plan, no time limit: 5 folders, 5 search results per search, 3 exports a day, 2 reminders at a time, 3 quick replies, 1 auto-file rule, 3 AI answers a day, 5 deal-board chats, 1 saved search.
Pro: US$4.99 one-time payment, no subscription, no free trial.

## Languages of the extension
English, Español, Português (Brasil), हिन्दी, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية.

## Questions people ask
Q: Does WhatsApp Web have folders?
A: Not as folders. WhatsApp has Lists (All, Unread, Favorites, Groups and custom lists); the Help Center steps for creating lists are written for Android and iPhone, and on WhatsApp Web which lists you see depends on your account. Labels belong to WhatsApp Business. WA Folders adds folder tabs on WhatsApp Web.

Q: How do I search WhatsApp Web by date?
A: Open the chat, click Search, click the calendar icon (Search By Date) and pick a day (WhatsApp Help Center, Web tab). Older days may be missing because WhatsApp Web holds only part of your history; your phone has the full history.

Q: How do I export a WhatsApp Web chat?
A: WhatsApp's own Export chat on the Web tab offers All messages or a Custom date range as a ZIP without media. WA Folders exports the open chat to HTML, CSV, Markdown or JSON.

Q: Who hasn't replied to me on WhatsApp Web?
A: WA Folders lists individual chats where you sent the last message and gets rid of the reminder when they reply.
